The six [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] known as the [[Dread Masters]] traveled in a '''dreadnaught''' during the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. The [[Harrower-class dreadnought|''Harrower''-class dreadnought]] ferried the Dread Masters between battles, and the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] wielded their power in [[Sith sorcery/Legends|Sith magic]] and [[Battle meditation/Legends|battle meditation]] to induce crippling fear in the crews of enemy vessels. In [[3668 BBY]], the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jaric Kaedan]]<ref name="Journal" /> stole security codes for the heavily-guarded ship and, along with [[Republic Special Forces Division|Special Forces]] strike team, boarded the dreadnaught using a stolen [[Unidentified Moff's yacht|yacht]] and [[Capture of the Dread Masters|captured]] the Dread Masters.<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=codex|Galactic History 89: Capturing the Dread Masters}}</ref> After securing the ship's databanks and setting the vessel to self-destruct, the strike team departed the dreadnaught with their captives.<ref name="Journal" /> With the ship's destruction, the Empire believed the Dread Masters to be [[Death/Legends|dead]], though they were imprisoned on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]; the Empire responded by [[Battle of Alderaan|attacking]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]<ref name="Codex" /> in [[3667 BBY]].<ref name="Journal">[[The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural (real-life book)|''The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural'']]</ref>
